description: Full machine-readable article (the JSON twin: facts, sources, call, full text). Use search_articles or get_latest first if you do not have a slug. Returns the article's complete JSON twin exactly as published — headline, summary, key facts, sources, the call the article makes (if any), and the full text. The slug must be lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens; an unknown or malformed slug returns an error, never a partial result. Behaviour: read-only and public — no authentication or API key; served from the site's published article files, and every call is logged in aggregate (tool name, query, result count, coarse client class; no IP addresses).

slug.description: Article slug, as returned by search_articles or get_latest, e.g. institutions-sold-the-dip.
